Manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]],<ref name="DB" /> '''Obsidian 2''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]] serving in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]]. Obsidian 2 was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Dodson Makraven/Legends|Dodson Makraven]], who operated under the designation of OS-72-2 and flew as [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] to<ref name="CCG1" /> Obsidian Squadron's lead pilot,<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=OS-72-1 In Obsidian 1}}</ref> [[Civé Rashon/Legends|Civé Rashon]].<ref name="CCG1" /> At one point, Obsidian 2 flew over<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW|set=Core Set|cardname="Night Beast"}}</ref> [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Obsidian 2 was created for a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG1" />
